description:
Lists of names in Hebrew and in Arabic script, among them Efraim b. Shemarya. The others include Yaʿaqov ha-Kohen b. Yosef; Shemuʾel b. Yosef; YKBR(?) b. Moshe; Yisraʾel Rosh Kalla b. Daniʾel (known from several other documents); and Natan b. Yehoshuaʿ. Dating: ca. 1007–1055 CE, based on the years when Efrayim b. Shemarya was active– but this date range may be narrowed through the chronology of other people mentioned in the list. AA/ASE

The Arabic portion needs further examination.
description_he: רשימות שמות בעברית ובכתב ערבי, ובהן אפרים ב"ר שמריה. תיארוך: כ-1007–1055 לספירה, בהתבסס על השנים שבהן היה אפרים ב"ר שמריה פעיל. AA
